instruction: Choose the appropriate tool from FreeCAD, LibreCAD, and KiCad, available in the current Ubuntu environment, to complete the task. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih17_conveyor_layout_seed.dxf. Complete the hard conveyor layout. Draw FRAME rectangle (0,70)-(760,190), BELT loop rectangle (10,60)-(750,200), fourteen ROLLER circles radius 18 centered at y=130 with x=50,100,150,200,250,300,350,400,450,500,550,600,650,700, MOTOR rectangle (610,205)-(730,275) and MOTOR circle center (670,240) radius 24, SUPPORT rectangles (160,30)-(195,60) and (580,30)-(615,60), and labels 14X ROLLERS Ø36 @ 50 PITCH, MOTOR DRIVE END, and CONVEYOR C-7. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih17_conveyor_layout_completed.dxf.
